key_insight: B-site disorder in Sr2FeRuO6 supports a Griffiths-like magnetic phase alongside strongly localized charge transport.
engineering_relevance: The findings inform disorder-aware design of magnetic and transport properties in spintronic oxides, rather than AI or solar-cell engineering.
method: Characterize monoclinic structure and B-site antisite disorder.
Measure magnetism to identify short-range ferromagnetic clusters.
Analyze temperature-dependent transport using hopping models.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a Griffiths phase extending well above the ordering temperature and a crossover from high-temperature small-polaron hopping to intermediate-temperature variable-range hopping.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative performance metrics or device validation, so application benefits remain unproven.
paper_title: Disorder-Induced Griffiths like Phase and Charge Localization in Sr2FeRuO6
